name: @correctiv/mobile
description: CORRECTIV community app — NativeScript 9 + Vue 3 + Vite (iOS/Android).

scripts.dev:ios: concurrently -k -n vite,ns "npm run dev:server:ios" "wait-on tcp:5173 && npm run ios"
scripts.dev:android: concurrently -k -n vite,ns "npm run dev:server:android" "wait-on tcp:5173 && npm run android"
scripts.build:android: cross-env NS_VITE_DIST_DIR=platforms/android/app/src/main/assets/app ns build android --release --key-store-path signing/correctiv-test.keystore --key-store-password correctiv-test --key-store-alias correctiv-test --key-store-alias-password correctiv-test
